clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Magis Sparkmantle sends novice mages to Ironforge at Bink's request. Bink needs an arcane specialist for her studies in the Hall of Mysteries.

Magis Sparkmantle sends word from his colleague Bink to mages training near Kharanos. She asks for an arcane specialist and will trust the matter only to someone who can wield magic. When an apprentice has outgrown the early exercises, Sparkmantle directs them to answer her call.

You travel to Ironforge's Mystic Ward, where scholars, priests, and arcanists gather in the Hall of Mysteries. Bink studies there and watches each arriving apprentice closely. Raw potential is only a beginning; without discipline, a spellcaster can become a danger in arcane work.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend! Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word. She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it! Are you that mage, friend?
If so, then speak with Bink. She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good mage. And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage. And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!
Oops, I'm getting ahead of things. Let's begin at the start!
